title.sk: Pečený losos so zemiakmi a kôprom
title.en: Baked salmon with potatoes and dill

description.sk: Celá večera z jedného plechu, plná bielkovín.
description.en: A whole dinner from one tray, full of protein.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C (horný a spodný ohrev, alebo 180 °C s ventilátorom). Zemiaky dôkladne umy – šúpať ich netreba – a nakrájaj na mesiačiky hrubé asi 1,5 cm, aby sa upiekli naraz. Cesnak ošúp a nasekaj nadrobno.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (conventional, or 180 °C fan). Scrub the potatoes well – no need to peel them – and cut them into wedges about 1.5 cm thick so they cook evenly. Peel and finely chop the garlic.

steps.sk: Na plechu vystlanom papierom na pečenie premiešaj zemiaky s 1 lyžicou oleja, cesnakom a polovicou soli. Rozlož ich v jednej vrstve reznou stranou nadol – tak sa krajšie opečú – a peč 20 minút.
steps.en: On a lined baking tray toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon of the oil, the garlic and half the salt. Spread them in a single layer, cut side down so they brown better, and roast for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým rozdeľ brokolicu na menšie ružičky; hrubú stonku ošúp a nakrájaj na plátky. Lososa osuš papierovou utierkou, aby sa nepiekol vo vlastnej šťave. Polovicu citróna nakrájaj na tenké plátky a druhú na mesiačiky na podávanie.
steps.en: Meanwhile cut the broccoli into small florets; peel the thick stalk and slice it. Pat the salmon dry with kitchen paper so it does not steam in its own juices. Slice half the lemon thinly and cut the other half into wedges for serving.

steps.sk: Plech vyber, zemiaky obráť a odsuň ich k okrajom. Do stredu polož lososa (kožou nadol, ak ju má) a okolo neho brokolicu pokvapkanú zvyšným olejom. Všetko osoľ zvyšnou soľou, okoreň a na lososa poukladaj plátky citróna.
steps.en: Take out the tray, turn the potatoes and push them to the sides. Put the salmon in the middle (skin side down, if it has skin) with the broccoli around it, drizzled with the rest of the oil. Season everything with the remaining salt and the pepper and lay the lemon slices on the salmon.

steps.sk: Peč ďalších 12 až 15 minút. Losos je hotový, keď sa v najhrubšom mieste ľahko rozdeľuje na lupienky a vnútri je ešte jemne ružový a šťavnatý (asi 50–55 °C); dlhším pečením vysychá. Zemiaky majú byť zlaté a mäkké.
steps.en: Roast for another 12 to 15 minutes. The salmon is done when it flakes easily at its thickest point and is still slightly pink and juicy inside (about 50–55 °C); longer roasting dries it out. The potatoes should be golden and tender.

steps.sk: Posyp všetko nasekaným kôprom a podávaj s mesiačikmi citróna na vytlačenie. Zvyšný losos vydrží v chladničke do druhého dňa a hodí sa aj studený do šalátu.
steps.en: Scatter over the chopped dill and serve with the lemon wedges for squeezing. Leftover salmon keeps in the fridge until the next day and is good cold in a salad.

title.sk: Pečené kuracie stehná so zeleninou z plechu

description.sk: Mäso aj príloha naraz v rúre – ideálne do krabičiek.
description.en: Meat and sides in the oven at once, ideal for lunch boxes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Zemiaky umy a nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. Mrkvu ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé 1 cm – je tvrdšia, preto potrebuje menšie kúsky. Cibuľu nakrájaj na osminky a papriku na široké pásiky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (conventional). Scrub the potatoes and cut them into roughly 3 cm chunks. Peel the carrots and cut them into 1 cm rounds – they are harder, so they need smaller pieces. Cut the onion into eighths and the pepper into wide strips.

steps.sk: Kuracie stehná osuš papierovou utierkou a väčšie prekroj na polovicu, aby boli kusy podobne veľké ako zelenina. Cesnak ošúp a pretlač. Vo veľkej mise zmiešaj olej, údenú papriku, cesnak, rozmarín, soľ a korenie.
steps.en: Pat the chicken thighs dry with kitchen paper and halve the larger ones so the pieces match the vegetables. Peel and crush the garlic. In a large bowl mix the oil, smoked paprika, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Do misy pridaj zeleninu aj mäso a rukami všetko dôkladne premiešaj, aby bol každý kúsok obalený. Rozlož na veľký plech (alebo dva) v jednej vrstve s medzerami – natlačená zelenina sa dusí namiesto toho, aby sa opiekla. Mäso daj navrch.
steps.en: Add the vegetables and chicken to the bowl and mix everything well with your hands until every piece is coated. Spread out on a large tray (or two) in a single layer with gaps – crowded vegetables steam instead of roasting. Put the chicken on top.

steps.sk: Peč 20 minút, potom plech vyber a zeleninu premiešaj alebo obráť, aby sa opiekla zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Roast for 20 minutes, then take out the tray and stir or turn the vegetables so they brown on all sides.

steps.sk: Peč ďalších 15 minút. Kura je hotové, keď má zlatú kôrku a v najhrubšom mieste dosiahne 75 °C – po prepichnutí vyteká číra šťava, nie ružová. Zemiaky a mrkva sa majú dať ľahko prepichnúť nožom; ak nie, peč ešte 5 minút.
steps.en: Roast for another 15 minutes. The chicken is done when it is golden and reaches 75 °C at its thickest point – the juices run clear, not pink, when pierced. The potatoes and carrots should be easy to pierce with a knife; if not, roast for 5 more minutes.

steps.sk: Nechaj jedlo 5 minút odpočinúť a polej ho šťavou vyškrabanou z plechu. Na meal prep ho rozdeľ do 4 krabičiek, nechaj vychladnúť a ulož do chladničky – vydrží 3 dni. Ohrievaj v mikrovlnke alebo v rúre pri 180 °C asi 10 minút.
steps.en: Let it rest for 5 minutes and spoon over the juices scraped from the tray. For meal prep, divide it between 4 containers, let it cool and refrigerate – it keeps for 3 days. Reheat in the microwave or in the oven at 180 °C for about 10 minutes.

title.sk: Šošovicový šalát s fetou a zeleninou
title.en: Lentil salad with feta and vegetables

description.sk: Svieži šalát do krabičky, ktorý vydrží v chladničke až tri dni.
description.en: A fresh lunch-box salad that keeps in the fridge for up to three days.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni v sitku studenou vodou a vyber prípadné kamienky. Daj ju do hrnca, zalej asi 1 litrom studenej vody a na vysokom ohni priveď do varu. Penu, ktorá vyplávala na povrch, zober lyžicou.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils in a sieve under cold water and pick out any small stones. Put them in a pan, cover with about 1 litre of cold water and bring to the boil over high heat. Skim off the foam that rises to the top.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň a var mierne 18 až 20 minút, kým šošovica nie je mäkká, ale stále drží tvar – ochutnaj zrnko, nemá byť múčnatá ani rozvarená. Vodu nesoľ; soľ pridáš do dresingu.
steps.en: Lower the heat and simmer gently for 18 to 20 minutes until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape – taste one; it should be neither chalky nor mushy. Do not salt the water; the salt goes into the dressing.

steps.sk: Kým sa šošovica varí, priprav dresing: v miske alebo v pohári so skrutkovacím viečkom vyšľahaj olej s octom, horčicou a soľou, kým sa nespoja do hustejšej emulzie.
steps.en: While the lentils cook, make the dressing: whisk the oil with the vinegar, mustard and salt in a bowl or shake them in a screw-top jar until they come together into a thicker emulsion.

steps.sk: Uvarenú šošovicu sceď, nechaj ju chvíľu odkvapkať a ešte teplú prelož do misy. Hneď ju premiešaj s polovicou dresingu – teplá šošovica nasaje chuť oveľa lepšie – a nechaj ju 10 minút vychladnúť, aby zelenina potom nezvädla.
steps.en: Drain the cooked lentils, let them drip for a moment and tip them, still warm, into a bowl. Toss them at once with half the dressing – warm lentils soak up flavour much better – and leave them to cool for 10 minutes so the vegetables do not wilt.

steps.sk: Medzitým paradajky rozpoľ, uhorku nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm a cibuľu nadrobno; ak je cibuľa veľmi ostrá, namoč ju na 5 minút do studenej vody a odkvapkaj. Petržlenovú vňať nasekaj.
steps.en: Meanwhile halve the tomatoes, dice the cucumber into about 1 cm cubes and finely chop the onion; if the onion is very sharp, soak it in cold water for 5 minutes and drain. Chop the parsley.

steps.sk: K vychladnutej šošovici pridaj zeleninu, vňať a zvyšný dresing a premiešaj. Navrch rozdrob fetu a podávaj. Na meal prep ulož šalát do krabičiek bez fety a fetu pridaj až pred jedlom; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Add the vegetables, parsley and remaining dressing to the cooled lentils and mix. Crumble the feta over the top and serve. For meal prep, pack the salad without the feta and add it just before eating; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Quinoa miska s pečenou zeleninou a tahini
title.en: Quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and tahini

description.sk: Farebná rastlinná miska plná vlákniny a bielkovín.
description.en: A colourful plant-based bowl full of fibre and protein.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C (horný a spodný ohrev). Batát ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm, brokolicu rozdeľ na ružičky a cibuľu nakrájaj na mesiačiky. Cícer sceď, prepláchni a dôkladne osuš utierkou – suchý sa v rúre opečie dochrumkava.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (conventional). Peel the sweet potato and cut it into roughly 2 cm cubes, cut the broccoli into florets and the onion into wedges. Drain and rinse the chickpeas and dry them thoroughly with a towel – dry chickpeas roast until crisp.

steps.sk: Na plechu vystlanom papierom premiešaj batát, cibuľu a cícer s 1,5 lyžicou oleja, údenou paprikou a polovicou soli a rozlož ich v jednej vrstve. Peč 10 minút.
steps.en: On a lined baking tray toss the sweet potato, onion and chickpeas with 1.5 tablespoons of the oil, the smoked paprika and half the salt and spread them in a single layer. Roast for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Brokolicu premiešaj so zvyšným olejom a pridaj ju na plech. Zeleninu premiešaj a peč ďalších 15 minút, kým batát nie je mäkký a na okrajoch karamelizovaný a brokolica nemá opečené špičky.
steps.en: Toss the broccoli with the remaining oil and add it to the tray. Stir the vegetables and roast for another 15 minutes until the sweet potato is soft and caramelised at the edges and the broccoli tips are browned.

steps.sk: Medzitým quinou dôkladne prepláchni v jemnom sitku pod tečúcou vodou – zmyješ tak horkastý povlak. V hrnci ju zalej 360 ml vody, pridaj štvrť lyžičky soli a priveď do varu. Prikry, zníž oheň na minimum a var 15 minút, kým nevsiakne všetku vodu.
steps.en: Meanwhile rinse the quinoa thoroughly in a fine sieve under running water to wash off its bitter coating. Put it in a pan with 360 ml of water and a quarter teaspoon of salt and bring to the boil. Cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and cook for 15 minutes until all the water is absorbed.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav a nechaj quinou 5 minút postáť pod pokrievkou, potom ju prevzdušni vidličkou. Správne uvarená je sypká a z každého zrnka vykukuje biely klíček.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and let the quinoa stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork. Properly cooked quinoa is fluffy and each grain shows a little white sprout.

steps.sk: Omáčka: cesnak pretlač a v miske ho vymiešaj s tahini, citrónovou šťavou a zvyšnou soľou. Tahini najprv zhustne a zrazí sa – to je v poriadku. Po lyžiciach prilievaj studenú vodu (asi 3 lyžice) a miešaj, kým omáčka nie je hladká a netečie ako hustá smotana.
steps.en: Sauce: crush the garlic and whisk it in a bowl with the tahini, lemon juice and remaining salt. The tahini will thicken and seize at first – that is normal. Add cold water a spoonful at a time (about 3 tablespoons), whisking, until the sauce is smooth and pours like thick cream.

steps.sk: Do misiek rozdeľ quinou, navrch daj pečenú zeleninu s cícerom a polej omáčkou. Na meal prep ulož quinou so zeleninou do krabičiek a omáčku zvlášť do malej nádobky; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a chutí studená aj ohriata.
steps.en: Divide the quinoa between bowls, top with the roasted vegetables and chickpeas and drizzle with the sauce. For meal prep, pack the quinoa and vegetables in containers with the sauce in a small pot on the side; it keeps for 4 days in the fridge and is good cold or reheated.

description.sk: Zamatová jesenná polievka s kokosovým mliekom a pražnými semienkami.
description.en: A velvety autumn soup with coconut milk and toasted seeds.

steps.sk: Tekvicu dôkladne umy – hokkaido sa nešúpe, šupka sa uvarí domäkka a dodá polievke sýtu farbu. Prekroj ju na polovicu, lyžicou vyber semienka a vlákna a dužinu nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, cesnak nasekaj a ošúpaný zázvor nastrúhaj najemno.
steps.en: Wash the squash well – hokkaido is not peeled; the skin cooks soft and gives the soup a deep colour. Halve it, scoop out the seeds and fibres with a spoon and cut the flesh into roughly 3 cm cubes. Finely chop the onion, chop the garlic and finely grate the peeled ginger.

steps.sk: Vo väčšom hrnci zohrej olej na strednom ohni a cibuľu na ňom zľahka opekaj asi 5 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezosklovatie – nemá zhnednúť. Pridaj cesnak a zázvor a miešaj ešte asi minútu, kým nezavoňajú.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and gently cook the onion for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent – it should not brown. Add the garlic and ginger and stir for about another minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Pridaj tekvicu, rozdrobený bujón a 800 ml horúcej vody; voda má tekvicu takmer zakryť. Priveď do varu, zníž oheň, prikry a var mierne 20 minút, kým kocky tekvice nejdú ľahko prepichnúť nožom.
steps.en: Add the squash, the crumbled stock cube and 800 ml of hot water; the water should almost cover the squash. Bring to the boil, lower the heat, cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the squash cubes are easy to pierce with a knife.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav, vmiešaj kokosové mlieko (plechovku pred otvorením pretrep) a ponorným mixérom mixuj aspoň minútu, kým nie je polievka úplne hladká. Ak mixuješ v stolnom mixéri, naplň ho najviac do polovice a vrch prikry utierkou – horúca polievka vystrekuje.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat, stir in the coconut milk (shake the can before opening) and blend with a stick blender for at least a minute until completely smooth. If you use a jug blender, fill it no more than halfway and cover the lid with a towel – hot soup splatters.

steps.sk: Polievku znova zohrej, ale už ju nevar, a dochuť soľou (asi pol lyžičky – bujón je slaný, preto ochutnaj). Ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu horúcej vody. Medzitým na suchej panvici na strednom ohni opraž tekvicové semienka 2 až 3 minúty, kým nezačnú praskať; daj pozor, rýchlo sa pripália.
steps.en: Reheat the soup without boiling it and season with salt (about half a teaspoon – the stock is salty, so taste first). If it is too thick, add a little hot water. Meanwhile toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until they start to pop; watch them, they burn quickly.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypanú opraženými semienkami. Vychladnutá polievka vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a v mrazničke 3 mesiace – zmrazuj ju bez semienok a po rozmrazení ju pred ohriatím dobre premiešaj.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with the toasted seeds. Cooled soup keeps for 4 days in the fridge and 3 months in the freezer – freeze it without the seeds and stir well after thawing before reheating.

description.sk: Sýte raňajky pred tréningom – 40 g bielkovín v miske.
description.en: A filling pre-workout breakfast with 40 g of protein in a bowl.

steps.sk: Do malého hrnca nasyp vločky a zalej ich mliekom. Postav na stredný oheň a za stáleho miešania priveď do mierneho varu – mlieko rýchlo pripáli dno a ľahko vykypí, preto od hrnca neodchádzaj.
steps.en: Put the oats in a small pan and pour over the milk. Set over medium heat and bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly – milk scorches on the bottom and boils over easily, so stay by the pan.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň a var ďalšie 3 až 4 minúty, stále miešaj, kým vločky nezmäknú a kaša nezhustne – lyžica by mala na dne hrnca na chvíľu zanechať stopu.
steps.en: Lower the heat and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes, still stirring, until the oats are soft and the porridge thickens – the spoon should leave a trail on the bottom of the pan for a moment.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav z ohňa a nechaj minútu postáť. Až potom vmiešaj proteín – vo vriacej kaši by sa zrazil do hrudiek a bol by gumový. Miešaj, kým kaša nie je hladká; ak je príliš hustá, prilej lyžicu-dve vody.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat and let it stand for a minute. Only then stir in the protein powder – in boiling porridge it curdles into rubbery lumps. Stir until smooth; if it is too thick, add a spoonful or two of water.

steps.sk: Banán ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska. Kašu preber do misky, navrch poukladaj banán, pridaj lyžicu arašidového masla a posyp štipkou škorice. Jedz hneď – kým postojí, ďalej hustne.
steps.en: Peel and slice the banana. Spoon the porridge into a bowl, top with the banana and a tablespoon of peanut butter and sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon. Eat straight away – it keeps thickening as it stands.

description.sk: Hotový za 10 minút bez varenia, plný bielkovín a vlákniny.
description.en: Ready in 10 minutes with no cooking, full of protein and fibre.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska, v miske ju zalej citrónovou šťavou a pridaj štipku zo soli. Kým pripravíš zvyšok, kyselina ju zjemní a nebude taká ostrá.
steps.en: Slice the onion into thin half-moons, put it in a bowl with the lemon juice and a pinch of the salt. While you prepare the rest, the acid mellows it so it is less sharp.

steps.sk: Fazuľu sceď v sitku, prepláchni studenou vodou, kým voda neprestane peniť, a nechaj dobre odkvapkať. Paradajky rozpoľ a petržlenovú vňať nasekaj nadrobno.
steps.en: Drain the beans in a sieve, rinse them under cold water until it stops foaming and let them drain well. Halve the tomatoes and finely chop the parsley.

steps.sk: Tuniak dôkladne sceď – pritlač ho viečkom plechovky – a vo väčšej mise ho vidličkou rozober na kúsky. Pridaj fazuľu, paradajky, vňať a cibuľu aj s citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Drain the tuna thoroughly by pressing it with the can lid, then break it into flakes with a fork in a larger bowl. Add the beans, tomatoes, parsley and the onion with its lemon juice.

steps.sk: Zalej olejom, osoľ zvyšnou soľou, okoreň a zľahka premiešaj, aby sa fazuľa nerozpučila. Ochutnaj a podľa chuti pridaj kvapku citróna. Podávaj hneď, napríklad s chlebom; v uzavretej krabičke v chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Pour over the oil, season with the remaining salt and the pepper and toss gently so the beans do not break. Taste and add a drop more lemon if you like. Serve straight away, for example with bread; in a closed container it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Čokoládový koláč z hrnčeka v mikrovlnke
title.en: Chocolate mug cake in the microwave

description.sk: Teplý dezert pre jedného za päť minút.
description.en: A warm dessert for one in five minutes.

steps.sk: Vyber veľký hrnček vhodný do mikrovlnky s objemom aspoň 300 ml – cesto pri pečení stúpne takmer na dvojnásobok. Nasyp doň múku, kakao, cukor, prášok do pečiva a soľ a lyžičkou ich dobre premiešaj, aby v kakau nezostali hrudky.
steps.en: Choose a large microwave-safe mug that holds at least 300 ml – the batter nearly doubles as it cooks. Add the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder and salt and mix them well with a teaspoon so no lumps of cocoa remain.

steps.sk: Prilej mlieko a olej a miešaj, kým cesto nie je úplne hladké; prejdi lyžičkou aj po dne a okrajoch hrnčeka, kde sa drží suchá múka. Čokoládu nalámaj na kúsky a zatlač ich do stredu cesta.
steps.en: Pour in the milk and oil and stir until the batter is completely smooth; scrape the bottom and edges of the mug, where dry flour hides. Break the chocolate into pieces and push them into the centre of the batter.

steps.sk: Ohrievaj na plný výkon (asi 800 W) 70 až 90 sekúnd. Koláč je hotový, keď vykysne a povrch je pevný, ale na dotyk ešte vlhký – prepečený stvrdne. Pri slabšej mikrovlnke pridávaj po 10 sekundách.
steps.en: Cook on full power (about 800 W) for 70 to 90 seconds. It is done when it has risen and the top is set but still moist to the touch – overcooked, it turns hard. In a weaker microwave add 10 seconds at a time.

steps.sk: Nechaj ho minútu postáť – dopečie sa a čokoláda v strede sa roztopí. Pozor, hrnček aj koláč sú veľmi horúce. Jedz rovno z hrnčeka, kým je teplý.
steps.en: Let it stand for a minute – it finishes cooking and the chocolate in the middle melts. Careful, the mug and cake are very hot. Eat it straight from the mug while warm.
